charts.title: Kepler-296 b: orbits around Kepler-296
charts.description: The orbits of Kepler-296's planets in this map from above, to scale, with Kepler-296 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Q1-Q17 DR25 Supplemental KOI Table, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname Q1_Q17_DR25_SUPPLEMENTAL_KOI_TABLE): P 10.8644095 d
